prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial photograph inside the glass entry checkpoint of a biotech laboratory during a fire-alarm credential-system fallback. An original adult fictional woman, visually guided only in facial appearance and hair by the supplied portrait, keeps long dark center-parted loose waves and visible adult facial proportions. She works as a clearly legible private security access-control officer: an adult private guard in a coherent non-police site uniform. Her charcoal duty system includes a structured jacket, shoulder epaulettes, facility security badge, pale blue collared shirt, dark tie, matching trousers, duty belt, and clipped radio. A red alarm beacon flashes above disabled primary turnstiles while adult visitors queue. At a portable fallback station, she compares one visitor credential with the access reader, checks the approved entry list and access log, confirms the visitor is approved for this facility, and the green reader state opens one controlled gate. Show her hands comparing one visitor’s temporary credential with a printed fallback roster and marking the entry line; her raised open hand directs the remaining queue toward that monitored lane. Keep the pass, green reader display, marked roster row, and opening gate in one causal chain. Use a three-quarter full-body composition with layered checkpoint depth, realistic fluorescent emergency lighting, a restrained red alarm reflection, an eye-level 35 mm documentary perspective, and coherent hands.
negative_en: 3D render look, fake-looking background, low resolution, warped walls, plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, illustration look, broken facial features, impossible perspective
